about: measure contests of 2024 in Maryland, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-md-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: Special Appeals - Retention - Anne K Albright

threshold.rule: Voters vote yes or no; rejection or a tie vacates the office, so more yes than no is needed
threshold.quote: If the voters reject the retention in office of a justice or judge, or if the vote is tied, the office becomes vacant ten days after certification of the election returns.

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (63) for the class 'statewide retention'
